highlights.title: Activity remembers
highlights.body: Queue is now Activity, and it keeps a history of past transfers, so you can see what moved even after a restart.

highlights.title: Downloads in the background
highlights.body: Downloads run in the background with live progress and a Cancel button, so you can keep browsing while they finish.

highlights.title: Tabs that work together
highlights.body: Drag files from one tab onto another to move them, and middle-click any breadcrumb to open that folder in a new tab.

highlights.title: Sort by size
highlights.body: Sort any folder by size, largest or smallest first, to find what is taking up space.

highlights.title: PDFs in Quick Look
highlights.body: PDFs get their own icon and a first-page thumbnail, and Quick Look opens them with fit-width and fit-page controls.

highlights.title: Trim audio
highlights.body: Cut audio files right in Quick Look, the same way you already trim videos.

highlights.title: Easier to read
highlights.body: Text, icons and control outlines now meet contrast guidelines in both light and dark themes, and the tray flyout follows your saved appearance.
